order: Build the dispatch layer over the existing registry as a router module at the repo root. Transcribe the plan's casting tables — rungs, roles, hard never-rules, the computed review matrix and mandatory-review set, the pool-state degradation ladder, the automatic-trigger rules, and the measured liveness and reserve numbers — into a data file the router reads rather than hardcodes. Implement a route function that resolves a role, alias-aware, failing closed on any ownership-invariant violation; implement casting through a degradation machine so degraded pool states recast, suspend, defer, or restrict dispatch; implement reviewer selection with no-self-family logic computed from the full co-author set, failing closed on unattributed or mixed-family authorship; implement the pre-dispatch reserve gate and its confirmation-arming step; implement automatic companion-task creation so a missing required companion blocks dispatch. Assemble it into a single pipeline and wire the new suite into CI. Mark any default the plan leaves silent as an explicit unstated choice.
claims: 74 checks went green, covering no-self-family behavior for every author-family combination, a 9,375-call sweep across all 625 bucket-state combinations confirming no mandatory-class dispatch ever produces a same-family closing verdict, context-shape rejection at dispatch, and an independent bidirectional transcription check against the plan's casting tables. Fail-closed loading was tamper-tested against registry corruption, never-rule violations, vendor/family mismatches, and off-ladder inputs. CI runs the suite; three defaults the plan leaves silent are marked as explicit unstated choices.
